title: Stellar Agent Guard PolicyConfig
description: CLI JSON representation of the Soroban PolicyConfig. Contract validation remains authoritative; update this schema whenever PolicyConfig or its validation rules change.

per_tx_cap.description: Per-transfer cap; 0 disables it. CLI encodes i128 as a decimal string.

assets.description: Allowlisted SAC contracts. Duplicate addresses are rejected.

protocols.description: Allowlisted protocol contracts. The contract rejects repeated contract addresses, even when their function lists differ.

recipients.description: Allowed recipient account addresses. Duplicate addresses are rejected.

recipient_window_caps.description: Per-recipient overrides keyed by recipient; duplicate recipients are rejected even when caps differ. 0 means fall back to the global window cap.

blocked_recipients.description: Denied recipient account addresses. Duplicate addresses are rejected.

asset_caps.description: Per-asset overrides keyed by asset; duplicate assets are rejected even when cap or paused values differ. Use paused=true to block an allowlisted asset without pausing the whole account.

active_until.description: 0 means unrestricted; otherwise must be greater than active_from (also enforced by the contract).

$comment: Standard JSON Schema cannot compare active_until numerically with active_from, detect address-list intersections, or enforce uniqueness by an object's key when the other values differ. PolicyConfig validation in src/lib.rs remains authoritative for those keyed duplicate and cross-field rules.

nonNegativeI128.description: Non-negative decimal i128. Contract validation additionally enforces the exact i128 upper bound and rejects cap values above MAX_CAP_MAGNITUDE (10^24; SPEC §8). The pattern cannot express that numeric ceiling, so the contract remains authoritative.

fns.description: Optional function allowlist; null is a wildcard. An explicit empty list or duplicate symbols is rejected by the contract.

paused.description: Block the contract even when otherwise allowlisted.
Block transfers for this asset even when it is allowlisted.
